notes: 0.19.1 - PR #27 test build (on the 0.19.0 release, PR not merged). Edge controls becomes a workspace: a dashboard with dedicated Slices, Rings, Sliders, Look, Handle and Edge settings screens, a bottom tab bar, and a Practice screen where you swipe in from a grip and rehearse the wheel without firing anything. The dashboard rolls up any missing Android grants under 'need attention'. The editor preview and the Home wheel now share the same drawing code, so the preview is the real wheel - your slices, app buttons, orb and rim levels included. Existing preferences carry over.
